news.title: Senior combo lifts Glen Ridge girls soccer over Fair Lawn
news.excerpt: Senior midfielder Ella Idalski scored a second-half goal off an assist from senior midfielder Chloe Moshos to lift Glen Ridge to a 1-0 road victory over Fair Lawn in Fair Lawn.

news.title: Sophomore records hat trick to power No. 9 Ridgewood girls soccer over Hackensack
news.excerpt: Sophomore midfielder Bella Wellock scored a hat trick to power Ridgewood, No. 9 in the NJ.com Top 20, to a 7-0 home victory over Hackensack in Ridgewood.
